items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 5 meals, which is not enough to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: You had dinner at 8 pm or later only 8.3% of the time, which is good. Having late dinners is linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You fasted for 12.0 hours on average overnight, and 14.3% of nights you fasted for 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared to coaching alone.
